name: Inkboard newsroom calendar
description: A newsroom's story calendar: desks, assignments with copy deadlines, daily editions, and a briefing specialist (a full workspace: seven format skills, five scripts with self-tests, schemas and a validator) whose briefings refresh on a schedule.

state.workspace: This workspace plans a newsroom's stories: desks are the accounts, assignments are stories with copy deadlines and reporters, and each daily edition holds the assignments due for it. Every time carries its zone; embargoes are honoured.
